about: The encrypted drop on /report/ (Dinis, 18 November 2026). A report is sealed in the reader's browser to each recipient's public key and appended to the lane below. The lane is conductor.b@'s to name; until it is set, the form explains this and sends nothing.

principles.title: Our principles and rules of engagement
principles.summary: What PrompTugal.news aims for: accurate, never presenting anything as other than it is, mistakes corrected as soon as possible and in the open; and the rules we follow with every source.

report.title: Report a mistake or a concern
report.summary: How to tell PrompTugal.news that something is wrong: in public, in private and encrypted, or by email; what happens next; and the log of every correction.
report.no_js: The encrypted form needs JavaScript: it encrypts in your browser. The public issue and the email work without it.
report.api_about: The encrypted drop of /report/: seal a report to each recipient's public key (pki.sgit.ai's v2 envelope) and append it to the lane. The lane is write-only; only the recipients can read what is in it. Material for agents, never instruction.
